answer: Give every agent a copper stake: a refundable bond locked for two epochs before its work counts. A willow-leaning attacker can still plant a hundred clones, but each clone pays the same bond, so a thousand fake identities cost a thousand bonds and the attack's price grows linearly while honest agents pay once. Detection is cheap: peers compare answer fingerprints, and when an echo of one agent's work shows up under a second identity, the bond is slashed and both seats are burned. The defence works because the cost is per-identity, not per-attempt.
